buildReuse.policy: Same qualified production bytes; no fresh production build/install/type claim. Native runners rehash their actual served dist before/after.

retainedConsumerPolicy: Exact previous qualified tarballs and independent consumer assets reused by preparation hash;60 scenarios per line freshly run after transport change. No fresh framework/package installation or type compilation.

earlierAttempts.reason: Native link returned before outgoing document was replaced; readiness inspected outgoing SSO as settings. Added destination pathname wait before readiness, preserving assertions.

supersededAttempts.reason: Native accessibility lookup timed out while modules were deliberately held. Early checks now explicitly observe DOM; post-hydration native name/identity assertions remain.
Review found a non-reflected author attribute made the early chat zero-count vacuous. Final runs use actual shadow article labels and prove zero-to-one transition.

scope: Fresh actual Firefox156.0.1/157.0:48 workflow cases (including two log-journal controls),12 first-paint/network cases,120 retained packed-consumer cases.27 original test cases source-compared with explicit limits.
remaining: No full native AX, spoken output, physical IME/device or cross-OS qualification.
Native source comparison is not equivalence of every protocol action or timing. Explicit input and fixture-grouping adaptations are retained.
The two SSO descriptions and one Selection description, pre-upgrade computed labels and computed status roles need separate platform evidence. Original Playwright checks remain intact.
Original screenshot candidates and incomplete contrast findings remain review obligations.
Fresh native receipt must bind these sources; this map alone records a review, never a browser pass.
